messages:
marta: quick sync on onboarding pipeline tradeoffs after the RFC. i want a minimal MVP: keep inline fast-accept and push heavier perf/compat into a scheduled async job.

kevin: MVP sounds good. define "fast-accept": artifact manifest check, tokenizer roundtrip on a few examples, small output sanity checks. no quant or perf.

anu: agree. for async validate we should include quant smoke, onnx/kv compatibility, per-model golden-set diff, and a perf microbench. make the async job idempotent.

ryan: how do we surface failures? i propose: async failures create a model-status=flagged and send an alert but do NOT auto-disable. routing should fall back to the previous pinned model when serving, unless explicit opt-in.

marta: +1. also add a "force_run" flag for critical customers or compliance. for cost control, run deep-validate on first publish, then sampled weekly.

kevin: descriptor additions sketch: compat_hints, staging_policy, artifact_signature. keep these advisory.

anu: job payload must include model_version, artifact_hash, idempotency_key, and run_config. worker writes telemetry pointers to the model audit log.

probe-bot: created ticket ADM-1507: implement async-validate MVP, descriptor proto update, and runbook for flagged models.

marta: i'll draft the PR for descriptor and a tiny worker prototype. kevin/anu please review in 48h.

kevin: i'll review.

anu: ✅ will take idempotency proto.
